beats.vo: I asked my team one question, and nobody said a word for two minutes.
What are you obsessed with? At first, nobody had an answer. Some said nothing. Some said... work.
But I wasn't looking for the answer that sounds good in a meeting. So I went first.
And then the room opened up. Adventure. Coding. Things people could talk about for hours.
I borrowed this question from the founder of Wispr Flow. He asks it when he hires.
We spend so much time checking skills and experience. What if we also asked what drives someone beyond the job?
Solving problems. Building things. Adventure. Understanding people. Getting better, every single day.
Being good at something makes you capable. Being obsessed with it makes you keep getting better.
So if I asked your team, would they have an answer? Would you?
